  1.  Discussion  of the Draft Downtown  The following key decisions/ agreements were
  Specific Plan ( Continued from January 8,  made by consensus:
  2024, meeting)  The area east of Euclid Avenue
  between Bonita Avenue and Acacia
  Avenue would be designated as part
  of the " Town Core" district, with
  development standards similar to the
  rest of the Town Core area.
  The minimum setback for
  developments  adjacent  to single-

  family residential properties would be
  increased from 15 feet to 20 feet.
  Language would be added to require
  a certain percentage ( e. g. 50% or
  higher) of ground floor residential
  units in certain areas to have entry
  doors facing the street.
  Dark sky lighting standards would be
  referenced to guide lighting
  requirements.

  Rezoning the Bonita/ Cataract site
  to public, semi- public with an
  overlay to allow commercial
  development along Bonita.
